summary: A 48-year-old Grand Junction man fell at least 120 feet from the Tooth and Claw climb at Mother's Buttress; a drone located him and a companion on a ledge 200 feet from the base, rescue climbers reached the pair, and the patient was helicopter-evacuated to a hospital in stable condition
location: Mother's Buttress north of Highway 141, Whitewater
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue; Gateway Fire Department; CareFlight; BLM
notes: Date pinned via Burlington Record story published 2024-02-19 ('rescued Saturday' = 2024-02-17, verified a Saturday). Highway 141 closed both directions during the rescue. | MERGED (run 358): advnture.com photo story of the same Tooth and Claw 120-ft fall (Mesa CrimeWatch photos).
